**Sub:** Clarifications on Transitory Provisions under section 64UM(3) read with regulation 27 # criteria to function as a Surveyor or Loss Assessor (SLA). In this regard, Section 64 UM (3) has given the power to the Authority to specify the time required to fulfil the stated criteria. Surveyors and Loss Assessors) Regulations, 2015 has prescribed three years time from the date of notification of these regulations for the existing licensed surveyors to fulfil the criteria set out in Section 64 UM (1 ). The regulations were notified on 30.10.2015. > supersedes the earlier regulations has prescribed criteria for categorization of surveyors on > the basis of level of membership allotted by the Indian Institute of - of > existing surveyors who fall in the transitory provisions of regulation 27 of the IRDAI (Insurance Surveyors and Loss Assessors) Regulations, 2015. Accordingly, the Insurers are advised that the surveyors holding a valid licence prior to the commencement of surveyors, utilization of surveyors and allotment of survey jobs, during the interregnum period of three years.
